title: Is a 2 Hour Boat Trip Enough in Madeira, or Should You Book 3 Hours?
description: Two hours is enough for a sunset run from Funchal to Cabo Girão. To swim, book the 2h30 Day Trip, and choose 3 hours to add 30 minutes west to Ponta do Sol.
heroAlt: Drone view of a white boat drawing a curved wake as it turns below Cabo Girão
keywords: is a 2 hour boat trip enough in Madeira
how long should a boat trip be in Madeira
Funchal to Cabo Girão by boat
3 hour boat trip Funchal Ponta do Sol
half day boat trip Funchal how long

images.prompt: Drone photo taken from high above the sea at the foot of Cabo Girão on Madeira's south coast, golden hour about 30 minutes before sunset. A white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy draws a long curved white wake as it turns back east, small in the frame. The huge dark cliff face rises along one side, its top edge lit warm orange, the terraced fields above it. The sea is deep blue going to gold towards the west. No faces visible. Realistic photo, natural colours.
images.alt: Drone view of a white boat drawing a curved wake as it turns below Cabo Girão
